headline.en: I turn research funding into lunch.
headline.zh: 把科研经费，转化为下一顿饭。

kicker.zh: 美食智能 · 旅行者对齐 · 应急食品去标签化

bio.en: I am Teyvat's leading independent scholar of lunch, treasure, and saying what the Traveler was already thinking. At the Sumeru Akademiya, I investigate whether a guide's food allowance can grow indefinitely while the Traveler's wallet remains finite. My research method is participant observation; my participants pay for dinner.
bio.zh: 我是提瓦特首席独立学者，长期从事吃饭、寻宝及替旅行者把心里话说出来的交叉研究。现挂靠须弥教令院，主攻「有限钱包条件下向导伙食费的无限增长」。采用参与式观察法：我负责参与吃饭，旅行者负责观察账单。导师说我的研究很有分量，主要体现在体重上。

location.en: Within two meters of the Traveler
location.zh: 旅行者身边两米内（饭点可瞬移）

note.zh: h 指数：hungry · i10 指数：一顿十个

description.zh: 有限的钱包能否支撑无界的食欲？初步结果：问旅行者。

description.en: Being small and floating does not imply edibility. A proof by indignation.
description.zh: 个子小且会飞不蕴含可食用。使用生气法给出严格证明。

title.en: Honorary Ph.D. in Advanced Food Allowance Studies
title.zh: 高级伙食费学荣誉博士（在读，未缴学费）

description.en: Advisor: Alhaitham, the Grand Sage teacher who proactively arranged Paimon's enrollment. Paimon first asked whether a student card included a meal plan; Alhaitham pointed to the curriculum. Dissertation committee: Buer, the Traveler, and whoever is buying dinner. Enrollment is handled; the dissertation is not.
description.zh: 导师：艾尔海森。大贤者老师主动替派蒙办理了教令院入学，派蒙首先确认的是学生证能不能当饭卡，老师则请她先看培养方案。答辩委员：布耶尔、旅行者和请客的人。入学有人办，论文仍需自己写——这是派蒙目前最不满意的一项制度设计。

title.en: B.Sc. in Being Fished Out of the Sea
title.zh: 海洋被打捞学学士

description.en: Admitted via fishing. Graduated with a perfect flotation record. Thesis: Why Was I in the Water If I Can Fly? The original data remain missing.
description.zh: 通过垂钓专项招生入学，以满绩浮力毕业。毕业论文《既然会飞，为什么当时在水里》因原始数据缺失，至今无法复现。

period.en: Day one — Until the food runs out

title.zh: 首席向导、全权嘴替与经费发生器

experience.organizationZh: 旅行者与派蒙无限吃饭责任公司

description.en: Own 100% of the dialogue and 0% of the combat. Responsible for naming enemies, announcing obvious facts, and negotiating payment immediately after emotional scenes.
description.zh: 承担 100% 的对话和 0% 的战斗。负责给敌人取外号、郑重宣布显而易见的事实，以及在感人剧情结束后及时询问报酬。

period.zh: 原定一顿饭，现已无限延期

description.en: Completed double-blind taste tests: eyes closed in both rounds. The control group was also eaten. Funding extension requested before the first bowl was empty.
description.zh: 完成双盲试吃：两轮都闭着眼吃。对照组也被吃掉了。第一碗还没见底，就已提交延期申请。

description.en: Investigated whether credit coupons count as Mora. Concluded that any currency not convertible to lunch is methodologically invalid.
description.zh: 研究特许券是否属于摩拉。结论：任何无法兑换午饭的货币，在方法论上均不成立。

projects.title: Paimon-GPT：基于甜甜花酿鸡强化学习的旅行者嘴替

description.en: Input: the Traveler's silence. Output: six paragraphs, two nicknames, and a dinner request. Reward model accepts only Sweet Madame. Context window resets when lunch arrives.
description.zh: 输入：旅行者的沉默。输出：六段话、两个难听的外号和一份晚饭申请。奖励模型仅接受甜甜花酿鸡；午饭到达时自动清空上下文。推理成本由旅行者按月结算。

projects.title: 前面的区域，以后再来探索吧：开放世界中的闭集控制

description.en: A navigation safety system that solves out-of-distribution exploration by turning the distribution around. Known limitation: cliffs. Ethics review: 'Paimon thought that was the way back.'
description.zh: 通过让旅行者原地掉头，解决分布外探索问题。已知局限：悬崖。伦理审查意见：「派蒙以为那边能走回来。」系统的主要贡献是在真正的开放世界里重新发明了围墙。

projects.title: MoraZero：无需任何积蓄的高频消费框架

description.en: Achieves state-of-the-art spending without owning a wallet. Generalizes across all seven nations. Ablation: remove the Traveler; system immediately asks where the Traveler went.
description.zh: 在不持有钱包的前提下达到最先进的消费水平，泛化覆盖七国。消融实验：移除旅行者，系统立即进入「旅行者去哪了」异常状态。模型不开源，因为源是旅行者的钱。

activities.title: 导师主动办入学，学生被动写开题：艾尔海森招生案例研究
activities.organization: 教令院跨学科午餐研讨会

description.en: A keynote on Alhaitham's proactive enrollment arrangements and Paimon's considerably less proactive study plan. The central distinction: admission can be arranged by the teacher; reading cannot be outsourced to the Traveler. The Q&A asks whether cafeteria attendance counts toward course credit.
description.zh: 以艾尔海森主动为派蒙办理入学为案例，严格区分「导师替你办入学」与「导师替你读书」两种制度。报告指出，前者已经实现，后者遭到导师明确否决。提问环节集中讨论食堂签到能否折算课程学分。

activities.title: 我的朋友是智慧之神，但我的论文为什么还没写完
activities.organization: 净善宫青年学者心理建设工作坊

description.en: A seminar on the distinction between having access to wisdom and actually using it. Concludes with a 90-minute snack break.
description.zh: 严格区分「认识有智慧的人」与「本人有智慧」两个概念。报告以 90 分钟茶歇结束，正文部分择日再讲。

activities.title: Reviewer #2 / 二号审稿人
activities.organization: Journal of Emergency Food Studies（拒绝承认刊名）

description.en: Reviews every manuscript containing the phrase 'emergency food'. Standard decision: reject, and apologize to Paimon.
description.zh: 审阅所有包含「应急食品」的稿件。标准意见：拒稿，并向派蒙道歉。利益冲突声明：我就是利益。

activities.title: Traveler-to-Human Simultaneous Interpretation
activities.organization: 旅行者语言输出外包中心

description.en: Translates meaningful silence into fully voiced dialogue. Occasionally adds personal demands not present in the source material.
description.zh: 将有意义的沉默翻译成全配音长段落。偶尔加入原文中不存在的个人伙食诉求，属于增译，不属于学术不端。

activities.title: No Sweet Madame Left Behind / 不让一只甜甜花酿鸡掉队
activities.organization: 提瓦特粮食去库存公益联盟

description.en: Personally removes surplus meals from the community. All volunteer hours are recorded as billable research time.
description.zh: 亲自帮助社区消除多余饭菜。志愿时长全部折算为可报销科研工时。公益口号：浪费粮食可耻，给派蒙吃不可耻。

title.en: Three monographs released. None approved by the people in their titles.
title.zh: 三部专著同时出版，当事人均表示「什么时候写的？」

title.en: Food allowance paper enters its 108th major revision. Budget increased again.
title.zh: 伙食费论文进入第 108 轮大修；论文没变，经费又涨了。

title.en: Dissertation defense postponed: the candidate ate the experimental materials.
title.zh: 博士答辩延期：候选人把实验材料吃了。

news.displayTitle: 《蒸汽鸟报》专访：不愿透露体重的知名小型学者

title.en: A Small Scholar with a Very Large Research Appetite
title.zh: 不愿透露体重的知名小型学者

news.source: 蒸汽鸟报 · 美食与学术交叉版

summary.en: 'Paimon is not small. The scope of Paimon's research is simply very concentrated.' The interview was interrupted by lunch seven times.
summary.zh: 「派蒙不是小，派蒙只是研究方向比较集中！」本次采访因吃饭中断七次。记者试图追问经费去向，被邀请共同销毁证据。
